name: Leather Wine Tote Bag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality premium PU leather, offering a smooth surface, elegant appearance, and durable everyday use.
    - Built with a sturdy 4mm thickness, giving the tote bag a structured shape and reliable support for bottle carrying.
    - Features a comfortable integrated handle for easy hand-carrying during dinners, parties, gifting, or travel.
    - Designed to fit most standard 750ml bottles, making it practical for wine, champagne, and similar bottle sizes.
    - The PU leather surface provides a stylish and refined look while remaining lightweight and easy to carry.
    - Available in 5 color variations: Berry, Wine Red, Black, Brown, Light Brown.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size:
             + Width: 17.5 cm ~ 6.89 in
             + Height: 42.5 cm ~ 16.73 in
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - Available in one-sided printing or two-sided printing depending on the customer's design.
    📌 Note: The bottom 2 cm is a non-print zone, as this area wraps and curves around the bottle base when inserted.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a wine tote bag and a personalized decorative gift holder.
    - Suitable for wine bottles, champagne bottles, and other similar standard-size bottles.
    - Great for dinners, parties, weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, holidays, picnics, and gift presentation.
    - Makes bottle gifting more elegant, personal, and convenient.
    - Lightweight and easy to carry while adding a premium presentation touch.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for wine lovers, couples, friends, family members, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, Valentine’s Day, Christmas, housewarmings, bridal showers, and - special celebrations.
    - Ideal for bridesmaids, best friends, couples, hosts, and anyone who enjoys wine-themed gifts.
    - Great as a reusable wine bag that adds both charm and function.
    - A stylish gift choice that combines elegance, practicality, and personalization 🍷🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Leather Wine Tote Bag

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.3-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
